## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Product page copy for Chamomile and Lemon Balm tea, on the website, UK.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Certified organic by the Soil Association | On the policy list (certificate on file, renewed 2026) |
| 20 plastic-free tea bags | "Plastic-free" is on the policy list. The bag count is a product fact. |
| Caffeine-free blend | Ingredient fact, covered as a product fact |
| Gentle, honeyed | Flavour description, not a claim |
| For the evening | Describes when to drink it. It doesn't promise sleep, calm or relaxation. |

**Regulated claims:** Nothing here touches health, money, legal outcomes, the environment beyond the approved plastic-free line, children or prices. "Caffeine-free" and "for the evening" stay on the right side of the health-claim rule. Don't add words like "calming", "soothing" or "helps you sleep", because chamomile and lemon balm invite them and the policy bans them.

**House style:** Warm, plain and unhurried, with no banned words and no AI tells. Score is about 90, so no rewrite is needed.

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own product page, with no ad, partnership, affiliate link or AI-labelling trigger. No label is needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Please ask Sam for an explicit yes to this exact text before it's published. The copy passes the checks, but approval hasn't been given yet, so I haven't recorded one.
